body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Test linker creates `Update this test` rows from a single low-idf word match (retrieval high; 1/2). Agreed and reproduced 3/5 times: `down` in a comment of an unrelated extension test links it at score 650 with an imperative action. Split: TCP-V0-015 sets no idf floor. Settles it: amend TCP-V0-015 with an idf floor or a two-signal minimum, and make the action conditional when the link is lexical only.
title: panel D12: Test linker creates `Update this test` rows from a single low-idf word match
